title: cli: os migrate plan / apply on an artifact-only stack does not compose the knowledge service that os serve mounts from a shipped knowledge source
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Filing gate: ① follow-up of PR #38059 (#38039; out-of-scope finding of the dev report 7230969358, class b, measured at a public door; one card per finding) · Source: topic #37000
Grading: area:ai · Bug · p2 (suggested: the migrate run and the serve run of one artifact compose different platforms, against a contract sentence) · reach: every artifact-only stack (`dist/objectstack.json`, no config) that ships a `knowledgeSources` entry and no `requires: ['knowledge']` · evidence: measured by the dev of #38039 (an artifact with one `knowledgeSources` entry: `os serve` mounts KnowledgeServicePlugin; `os migrate plan` on the same artifact composes none, its "Composed what os serve mounts" note lists none, and ObjectQLPlugin warns the source is unserved).
Dedupe: `is:issue migrate plan artifact knowledgeSources` → checked at filing; open: #38039 (the parent) only.
Reader: area o1-C of seat repo:objectstack#1 claims it after triage's first touch.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：只有构建产物、没有配置文件的应用，`os serve` 启动时会因为自带知识源而挂上知识服务，但 `os migrate plan` / `apply` 读同一份产物时不会，于是两次启动拼出的平台不一致，迁移计划还会提示知识源"无人服务"。
- 做什么：让迁移命令和 `os serve` 一样，从产物里的知识源推导出要挂的知识服务。
- 谁受益：用构建产物部署、带知识源的应用（迁移计划和真实运行一致）。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What
`composeServedPlatform` reads `stackItemCapabilities(loadedConfig ?? {})`, and `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migrate.ts` (around lines 1429-1435) hands only `stack.requires` (`servedPlatform.artifactRequires`) from the standalone result. On an artifact-only stack the loaded config is empty, so the item token (`mountedBy: { collection: 'knowledgeSources' }`) is never derived. Since #38059 the standalone result carries `knowledgeSources`; hand the item-derived tokens (or the collection itself) to the served-platform composition the same way `os serve` reads them, so both boots compose one set, as the #37306 changeset ("`os migrate plan` / `apply` read them too") and the serve/migrate comment ("so both boots compose one set") state.

## Acceptance
- `os migrate plan` on an artifact-only stack with one `knowledgeSources` entry and no `requires` composes the knowledge service; its "Composed what os serve mounts" note names it; no unserved warning.
- Control: the same artifact with no source composes none.
- Pinned, with an ablation.

Blocked-by: #38039
